companies.name: Dollar Tree, Inc.
companies.description: Dollar Tree operates a national discount variety retail chain selling a wide assortment of low‑priced general merchandise to individual consumers. They focus on high‑volume sales of everyday consumables, household items, party and seasonal products, and basic personal care and grocery items, and they market themselves as a value retailer offering fixed low prices and convenient assortment across stores and digital channels.

companies.name: Allied Universal
companies.description: Allied Universal provides integrated security and facility services to organizations, delivering on-site security personnel combined with technology and professional services for businesses and institutions; they serve corporate, event, property management, and institutional customers and position themselves as a nationally supported, locally delivered partner using a risk-based, people-plus-technology approach.

companies.name: Emerson Electric Co.
companies.description: Emerson Electric Co. designs and manufactures automation and control technologies, including process control systems, valves and actuators, sensing and analytical instruments, and HVAC/refrigeration controls, and provides related software and services. They primarily sell to industrial operators, OEMs, building and facilities managers, and systems integrators. They position themselves as a single-source supplier of control hardware, instrumentation, and software to support operational control and equipment lifecycle needs.

companies.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
companies.description: Meta Platforms, Inc. develops and operates widely used social networking and messaging applications and an advertising platform for businesses, while also building augmented/virtual reality hardware and software. They serve individual users who access their social and communication services and businesses that use their advertising, analytics, and developer tools. They position themselves as a provider of social connectivity and immersive experience technologies that enable communication, content sharing, and immersive computing.

companies.name: Google
companies.description: Google is a multinational technology company that specializes in internet-related products and services. Its offerings include online advertising technologies, search engine, cloud computing, software, and hardware. Google's typical customers include consumers, businesses, advertisers, and publishers who use its various products and services for different reasons. Google positions itself as a company that offers innovative and user-friendly technology solutions that aim to make the world's information accessible and useful.

companies.name: Los Angeles Department of Water and Power
Commonwealth Electric Company of the Midwest
Summit Line Construction
companies.description: Summit Line Construction provides electrical utility construction services focused on transmission and distribution line work, energized operations, substation construction, and foundations/drilling for grid projects. They serve utilities, renewable energy developers and large infrastructure contractors and claim to differentiate through a stated safety culture, labor affiliation, and emphasis on linking sustainable energy to the grid.

companies.name: Verra Mobility Corporation
companies.description: Verra Mobility Corporation is a leading provider of tech-enabled smart transportation solutions, including tolling, violations, and title and registration services. Their typical customers include transportation agencies, rental car companies, fleet owners, and municipalities. They differentiate themselves by offering innovative and reliable solutions that improve mobility and safety while also creating a seamless and convenient experience for both customers and end users.

companies.name: DeBra-Kuempel Inc.
companies.description: DeBra-Kuempel Inc. is a mechanical construction and maintenance company that offers a range of services, including HVAC, plumbing, process piping, and industrial ventilation. Their typical customers are commercial and industrial clients in various sectors, such as healthcare, education, manufacturing, and government. DeBra-Kuempel Inc. differentiates themselves by emphasizing their extensive experience, technical expertise, and commitment to customer satisfaction. They position themselves as a trusted partner for mechanical construction and maintenance needs, providing high-quality solutions tailored to each client's specific requirements.

companies.name: Aldridge Group
companies.description: Aldridge Group provides IT consulting, managed services, cybersecurity solutions, cloud services, and digital transformation services. Their typical customers are businesses of all sizes, from small companies to large enterprises, across various industries. They position themselves as a trusted partner that helps their clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals. They claim to differentiate themselves through their proactive approach to IT management, personalized customer service, and their expertise in cybersecurity.

companies.name: Danella Companies
companies.description: Danella Companies provides heavy civil and infrastructure construction services focused on site development, underground utilities and electrical/traffic systems, and roadway construction and paving for public agencies and private developers. They position themselves as a full‑service contractor with integrated capabilities and in‑house equipment to manage large-scale infrastructure projects from excavation through final paving and systems installation.

companies.name: J & M Brown Company, Inc.
companies.description: J & M Brown Company, Inc. is an electrical contracting firm that delivers electrical construction and low-voltage system services to construction managers, owners, and developers in commercial, institutional, and life science sectors; they emphasize integrated electrical, fire alarm, security and tel/data capabilities, a safety-first workforce, and project coordination to support complex builds.

companies.name: Cerris
companies.description: Cerris is a national commercial construction and MEP contractor offering general contracting, design-build, preconstruction, construction management, building automation, and service for commercial clients; they emphasize integrated solutions for complex projects, long-term client relationships, and employee ownership.

companies.name: Allan Briteway Electrical Utility Contractors, Inc.
companies.description: Allan Briteway Electrical Utility Contractors, Inc. is an electrical contracting firm that provides electrical installation and contractor services to Fortune 500 companies and commercial, pharmaceutical, industrial, medical, educational, communications, and municipal organizations; they emphasize over 60 years of experience and position themselves as a trusted, reliable provider built from merged predecessor firms.

companies.name: Eii Electric Inc
companies.description: Eii Electric Inc. is an electrical and mechanical contracting firm serving commercial and industrial clients with electrical construction, mechanical construction, communications/security systems, and maintenance services, and they emphasize a multi-disciplinary team approach built from decades of experience and targeted business growth.

companies.name: Carr & Duff, Inc
companies.description: Carr & Duff, Inc provides electrical construction and contracting services with an emphasis on 24/7 emergency response, utility and communication systems construction, and deployment of manpower and equipment for projects serving utilities, transportation, healthcare, wireless communications, industrial, commercial, and institutional clients.

companies.name: B&G Electrical Contractors of New York
Ready Electric Company, Inc.
companies.description: Ready Electric Company, Inc. provides design-build electrical construction and technology services for business and institutional clients, focusing on BIM modeling, prefabrication, power distribution, low-voltage systems, and 24/7 service. They serve sectors such as healthcare, industrial, institutional, sports venues and data centers, and they claim faster, more accurate installations through in-house prefabrication and geospatial/Trimble technology and by operating as an ESOP.

companies.name: MGE Underground, Inc.
companies.description: MGE Underground provides underground utility and electrical distribution construction services for utilities and infrastructure owners, focusing on electric distribution work, trenchless installation, EPC project delivery, and emergency response. They emphasize safety-first operations, organized project management, and specialized crews as differentiators.

companies.name: Mill Plain Electric
companies.description: Mill Plain Electric is a full-service electrical contractor specializing in traffic signals and roadway lighting while also providing industrial, commercial, healthcare, and design-build electrical services to business and government customers; they emphasize long-term customer relationships, a well-trained staff, and multi-decade experience.

companies.name: Kroeschell Inc.
companies.description: Kroeschell Inc. provides design-build MEP engineering and turnkey facility services for institutional and commercial clients, offering project delivery (general contracting and MEP design-build) plus ongoing maintenance and operations for critical building systems. They serve large corporations, healthcare, government, education, industrial and data center clients and position themselves as an experienced, employee-owned facilities engineering and operations partner focused on proactive maintenance, safety and sustainability.

companies.name: LVC Companies, Inc.
companies.description: LVC Companies provides design, installation, integration, inspection, maintenance, monitoring, and emergency service for fire protection, life-safety, security, and communications systems for commercial, industrial, government, education, healthcare, and property management customers. They position themselves as simplifying complex technology and offering 24-hour service while emphasizing safety, connectivity, and customer-focused solutions.

companies.name: Precision Electric Group
companies.description: Precision Electric Group provides electrical construction and contracting services for commercial and institutional clients, covering ground-up projects, build-outs, renovations, installations, design-build, and maintenance; they emphasize delivering projects on time and on budget, flexibility to work around client schedules, and acting as an ongoing maintenance partner.

companies.name: Standard Electric
companies.description: Standard Electric is a distributor and retailer of electrical and lighting supplies serving trade professionals and business customers as well as retail shoppers; they offer a broad product catalog (lamps, ballasts, conduit, wiring, tools, batteries) through an online ordering platform with business account features, branch pickup, and customer support.

companies.name: Escoe Industrial
companies.description: Escoe Industrial provides industrial and commercial maintenance and fabrication services to manufacturing and commercial operations. They offer custom metal fabrication and welding, electrical installations and controls, and mechanical services including millwright work and plant relocations. They market themselves as a 24-hour service provider with broad shop capabilities, trained staff, and an emphasis on efficiency and fair pricing.

companies.name: Mayers Electric Co., Inc.
companies.description: Mayers Electric Co., Inc. is an electrical contracting firm that provides emergency electrical service, construction and renovation wiring, design/build projects, machinery wiring, lighting controls, data/communications cabling, fire alarm installation, and thermal scanning for commercial and institutional clients; they emphasize licensed operations, round-the-clock service, and a long operating history.

companies.name: Mark One Electric
companies.description: Mark One Electric provides advanced electrical knowledge, experience, and service to general contractors, developers, facility managers, and business owners across the Midwest region. Their offerings include power, data, lighting, and renewable energy solutions. They position themselves as Kansas City's most trusted electrical partner, highlighting their expertise, safety record, and ability to handle various project types in the sports, infrastructure, entertainment, civic, data center, industrial, healthcare, and education sectors.
